Family income level (level_of_income: high, moderate, low), mother report, banded by the Turkish Statistical Institute classification (thresholds not reported). Mother's education (mother_education), mother report, binary: <= 8 years (primary) vs > 8 years (high school to college). The cut falls inside Secondary school or less and the upper band spans all three levels, so it cannot be placed.

Household location (household_location: urban 161, rural 49), mother report, classified by the Turkish Statistical Institute settlement classification (thresholds not reported). Binary source: Urban and Rural only; proximate.
Household type only (family_structure: nuclear 187, extended 23), mother report; it does not record which parental figures live with the child, and neither type forces one schema category.
Daily gaming time asked in four duration bands, scored as hours on st_game.
Structured survey form designed by the study team (doi:10.5152/TurkArchPediatr.2022.21359, Methods); not a published instrument.
Mothers completed the survey form, including the gaming filter and duration items, in the outpatient waiting area; no who-answered variable (doi:10.5152/TurkArchPediatr.2022.21359, Methods).

'Total daily electronic screen time' (daily_screentime), mother report, two bands (<= 1 h, > 1 h); a dichotomous guideline cut gives no hours and the preregistration excludes dichotomous screen measures. Gaming time is on st_game.

Mother-reported daily video gaming time, asked of children who play 'video games on a computer, smartphone, tablet or game console' (indoors and out), usual day. Bands 20-30, 31-60 and 61-120 minutes at their midpoints (25, 45.5, 90.5 min / 60); top band '> 120 minutes' = 2. Never-gamers (video_gaming = 0, 140) are routed past the item and take 0 (non-users rule). By design the sample holds only never-gamers and children gaming at least 20 minutes a day for the past 6 months, sampled 1:2.
